data.cultural_impact: Kartikay is celebrated as Kartik Purnima or Tripuratrayodashi in Hindu culture. This day is dedicated to Lord Shiva. According to Hindu mythology, on this day, Lord Shiva destroyed the three demons who troubled the gods and created troubles.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, Kartikay represents the annihilation of ego and negative tendencies present within an individual. He symbolizes devotion, dedication, and the purifying power of Lord Shiva. Worshipping Lord Kartikay is believed to provide blessings for success, wealth, and happiness.
